name: grokbot
description: Operate Cursor's Grok Bot desktop app from the terminal: agents, sections, pins, transcripts, host gateway, Cursor RPC, and Electron CDP.

scripts.build: npx --yes esbuild@0.24.0 bin/grokbot.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/grokbot.mjs --banner:js='import { createRequire as __cr } from "node:module"; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);' --log-level=warning && chmod +x dist/grokbot.mjs
